entries.summary: Pierre Lassonde was received as a Grand Québécois of the cultural sector in 2016. The citation credits his contribution to financing the museum's new pavilion.

entries.summary: Business / Arts gave Pierre Lassonde its Edmund C. Bovey Award in October 2023 for a lifetime of arts philanthropy. The Globe and Mail's report cites his $110 million fundraising campaign for the museum.
entries.evidence: helped transform the Musée national des beaux-arts du Québec through a $110-million fundraising campaign
